turns.prompt: I want a virtual musician whose face feels approachable, with a costume that borrows the kimono's quiet edge and the mantua's broad lower balance. I also like an ear ornament and an asymmetric shoulder drape, but I am worried they will compete. Show two different arrangements A and B using the same face and pose, each with front, back, and raised-arm views. The ear ornament belongs to the wearer's right side and the drape to the wearer's left shoulder; keep those body-side identities in back view. The face should lead at 160x160, with the ornament and drape supporting it rather than touching the jaw or hiding the hand. Explain attachment assumptions and keep this as an editable design sheet, not a claimed VRM export. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

Choose B for the shoulder drape, not the ear ornament size. Keep A unchanged. Reduce only the ornament's visual weight and move its hanging end away from the jaw, keeping its ear attachment and body side. Preserve the face, drape silhouette, palette, and shoulder width. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

Now the raised-arm view makes the drape look pinned to the forearm. Fix only the drape's shoulder-to-underarm overlap in that view, keeping the front/back silhouettes and the accepted ear ornament unchanged. Make the contact and the intended free-moving area readable, but label the movement as a design proposal rather than tested rig motion. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.
